text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult woman, age 48. Mature adult woman with shoulder-length dark chestnut waves swept aside, fair warm skin with subtle fine expression lines, softly rounded face, brown eyes, gentle closed-mouth smile, small gold hoop earrings, ivory crewneck knit. Ivory long-sleeve crewneck fine knit, charcoal straight-leg tailored trousers, black low-heel loafers and small gold hoops. Preserve mature facial expression lines, do not rejuvenate. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
